description: This Java class parses XML feeds from StackOverflow, extracting entries such as titles, links, and summaries from the provided InputStream. It is designed to process StackOverflow XML data and provide a list of parsed entries.

classes.name: StackOverflowXmlParser
classes.description: Main class that provides methods to parse StackOverflow XML feeds and produce a list of entries.

classes.name: StackOverflowXmlParser.Entry
classes.description: Represents a single post entry with title, link, and summary fields parsed from the XML feed.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the input stream containing the XML feed and returns a list of Entry objects.

methods.name: readFeed
methods.description: Reads the entire feed from the parser and returns a list of parsed entries.

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Processes an individual 'entry' element in the XML and returns an Entry object.

methods.name: readTitle
methods.description: Extracts the text content of a 'title' element.

methods.name: readLink
methods.description: Extracts the URL from a 'link' element, especially when rel='alternate'.

methods.name: readSummary
methods.description: Extracts the text content of a 'summary' element.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Retrieves the text content within a tag.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips over unwanted or irrelevant XML tags.
